title: Dual Memory Networks: A Versatile Adaptation Approach for Vision-Language Models
caption: Figure 2. An illustration of the overall framework of our Dual Memory Networks (DMN), which integrates knowledge from three sources (i.e., text input, historical test data, and optional training images) to tackle the three types of adaptation tasks (i.e., zero-shot, few-shot, and the recently-proposed training-free few-shot adaptations).
